name: MIT Holdings CO.,LTD.
summary: MIT Holdings Co., Ltd. is in the information service business. It provides system integration for social infrastructure and network infrastructure, mainly in public services, telecommunications, finance, energy and logistics. It also offers digital marketing solutions, including Wisebook, a cloud service that creates, distributes and analyzes books from PDF data, and drone-related offerings. Dating from 1990, it has its headquarters in Chiba, Japan.
